embedded_normalizer_static_review.platform: Linux-only collection helper; uses POSIX UID and O_NOFOLLOW, not a claimed Windows/native runner.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.inputs: Exactly raw-path/known collection/output-path/recorded API-exit arguments; accepts only literal exit0 and workflow_runs/jobs/artifacts. API status must come from the real captured command, not an assumed0.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.read_ownership: Absolute raw/output paths, equal canonical same-owner parent; non-symlink nofollow raw open; regular UID-owned nlink1 file; positive size <=64MiB. fstat before/after plus path lstat device/inode/UID/mode/linkcount/size/mtime/ctime and exact read length prevent acceptance of an observed changed stream.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.decode: UTF-8; only JSON whitespace skipped between every raw_decode object; consumes to end. object_pairs_hook rejects duplicate keys, parse_constant rejects NaN/Infinity and finite_float rejects overflow to nonfinite. No page/trailing garbage is discarded.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.page_identity: At most64 pages and100 items each; exact-int total_count 0..6400 remains stable; list items are dictionaries with exact positive-int unique IDs across all pages. Nonempty page sequence and total_count == distinct ID count required. Failure/cap/partial/trailing/missing records stay failures.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.write_ownership: Parent device/inode/UID rechecked before output; encoded derivative carries raw filename/bytes/SHA/actual accepted exit0 and complete pages. Exclusive nofollow create0600; flush+fsync; no replacement of a prior raw/derivative, and a partial failed output is retained.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.side_effect_boundary: Source imports only stdlib. No network/subprocess/cleanup/removal/Git mutation/dynamic project import or embedded API dispatch. Its only prospective write is the explicit new derivative; stdout is a compact identity record.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.semantic_limit: Completeness decoding is not repository/ref/source/actor/workflow/attempt validation, active-run absence, dispatch association, artifact custody or readiness. The packet separately retains all such gates and future authorization requirements.
embedded_normalizer_static_review.static_review_limit: No normalizer inputs, fixtures, mutation tests or future commands were executed. Approval is for the held preparation source, not a successful parser execution receipt.
